packing.label: Vacation
packing.subject: Restaurants: a new phone app for every place we ate, home A of restaurants/design/home-2026-11-21 with C's Always get row and E Stamps for the times, in Weight's look and motion. The Map tab is the picked country's satellite map with a bubble per city (its best score), country chips over it; under it Always get (every Rainbow dish), the city chips, and Vacation's GO BACK / SKIP / NOT RATED. A city opens on its restaurants as score pins, the tapped one a card. Best (Best | Most eaten at) and Search (names, cities, dishes) tabs. A restaurant: its map (Google Maps on a tap), the stamps card (ten a card), We ate here, its score and every dish with Vacation's stars (halves, ×N, Rainbow); Edit with Where I am or a Google Maps link, Country and City.
